propositions: The current clarity score rewards volume (length thresholds, any H2 heading, any dash bullet) and legacy per-type shape instead of the author guide's leaf/container contract, letting padded tickets pass.
The clarity score is duplicated in gates.py and det_floor.py, and the det_floor copy lacks the bug branch, risking drift when extending both copies.

Recommended deterministic additions include altitude-keyed required-section shape, per-AC verification coverage, placeholder-free executable scope, grounded file_impact edit-sets, AC text hygiene, and conditional testing-shape markers.
Semantic judgments (persona quality, mechanism correctness, rationale, alternatives, coherence, child coverage) should remain LLM-reviewed rather than made deterministic.
Scoring should be derived from satisfied/applicable named checks with per-check evidence rather than adding points to the existing seven-point length-based scale.
